about.title: About Vårt Marked
about.p1: Vårt Marked opened its doors on Fossumveien in Oslo in 2016 and has been a trusted neighbourhood grocery store ever since. Our experience, however, goes back more than 25 years — from earlier years in another city, under another name. With an average of more than 3000 items, we represent many different countries and cultures.
about.p2: Here you will find products from Norway, Turkey, Thailand, Iran, Russia, Greece and many other countries. It matters to us that every customer finds what they need — whatever culture they come from.
about.p3: Can't find what you are looking for? Get in touch and we will check whether we can bring the item in. We work continuously to maintain the quality of our products.
about.p4: Our goal is to get better every single day and to give our customers the best service we can offer. Thank you for shopping with us!
